feature.title: Convert all 18 components from pure HTML-returning functions to controller factories

tasks.title: Create component controller factory pattern and convert 8 simple display components
tasks.description: Convert 8 stateless/simple display components: badge, status-dot, spinner, skeleton-card, skeleton-table, empty-state, user-avatar, copy-button. Each exports `createX(opts)` returning `controller({ template, state, methods })`. Composition via `toString()` → `data-cid` swap. Simple display components use minimal state (just props passed at creation).
acceptanceCriteria: Each file exports `createX(opts)` not `function x(...)` returning HTML string
Each factory returns `controller({ template, state, methods })`
Props passed at creation time stored as initial state
Setters provided as methods: `setLabel(l)`, `setVariant(v)`
Composition works: `${createBadge({variant:'success',label:'OK'})}` produces valid data-cid placeholder
All existing esc() calls preserved in templates
No regression in component HTML output

tasks.title: Convert 5 interactive components to controller factories
tasks.description: Convert components with user interaction: tab-bar, search-input, pagination, time-slot-grid, date-picker. These handle clicks, input changes, and need ctrl.trigger() for event binding. On-change callbacks passed as constructor options, invoked from controller methods.
acceptanceCriteria: Each file exports `createX(opts)` returning controller
Event handlers use ctrl.trigger(), never raw addEventListener
onChange/onSelect/onPage callbacks passed in opts, called from controller methods
Debounced inputs use debounce() wrapper on controller method
Active/selected state managed via ctrl.render(), not DOM manipulation
Ctrl.destroy() cleans up all triggers and timeouts

tasks.title: Convert 5 complex overlay components to controller factories
tasks.description: Convert components that manage open/close state and portal-like behavior: modal, confirm-dialog, toast, form-field, data-table. These have internal lifecycle (open/close transitions, auto-dismiss timers for toasts).
acceptanceCriteria: Each file exports `createX(opts)` returning controller
Modal/dialog: open/close methods on controller, isOpen in state
Toast: auto-dismiss via ctrl.defer(), cleanup on destroy
Form-field: validation state managed locally, error display via ctrl.render()
Data-table: sort state, column config, row data all in controller state
All use ctrl.trigger() for event binding
Ctrl.destroy() cleans up all timeouts, triggers, and DOM

tasks.title: Add destroy chain verification to all component controllers
tasks.description: Verify every component controller properly cleans up: timeouts via ctrl.defer(), event listeners via ctrl.trigger(), subscriptions via ctrl.unsub(). Components destroyed when parent view controller is destroyed (via destroy chain).
acceptanceCriteria: Every component controller's destroy() method works correctly
No leaked timeouts: create/destroy 20 times, no pending timers
No leaked event listeners: create/destroy 20 times, no duplicate handlers
No leaked global refs: window.__app and window.__el clean after destroy
Symbol.dispose present on all controllers (framework auto-handles)
